P01.rationale: The page features two men shaking hands as a large, prominent portrait that dominates the visual field.

P05.rationale: There are no case studies or client portraits present on this single-page hero layout.

P07.rationale: No social-proof apparatus such as a press wall, rating cards, or review grid is visible.

P10.rationale: There are no oversized decorative typographic elements like giant ghost numerals or large quote glyphs.

P11.rationale: No real data-visualisations bound to numbers (charts, cost-math) are present; only a headline is visible.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text and imagery.

P13.rationale: The background is flat blank white space behind the subjects, lacking an intentional texture or atmosphere.

P14.rationale: While not a full-bleed photo, the overlaid text sits directly on the image without sufficient darkening or scrim to ensure readability.

P16.rationale: No device/product mockup is shown in this hero shot.

N07.rationale: The handshake imagery appears generic and stock-like rather than specific to a real business context.

N08.rationale: There are no large empty regions with dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed.

N10.rationale: Text sits directly on the busy photo without a scrim or darkening, making it difficult to read.
